source_title: Lift crashes down at high speed in Mumbai suburban's 7-storey building; 8 injured
source_excerpt: NALASOPARA: Eight people were seriously injured after a lift in a seven-storey residential building, Dhananjay Avenue, at Patankar Park in Nalasopara (West), came crashing down on Saturday around noon.The injured were rushed to a nearby hospital by fellow residents.Nalasopara police visited the spot and inspected the site after being alerted about the incident.According to residents, the eight people were travelling in the lift from the fifth floor to the ground floor around 12 pm when it suddenly plunged down at high speed.Hearing a loud impact, other residents rushed to the spot and managed to break open the lift door after considerable effort.They rescued the injured occupants and shifted them to a nearby hospital, where they are currently undergoing treatment.The injured include advocate Satish Bhondve, a resident of the building, and seven of his guests."The occupants fell on top of one another inside the lift. Several of them have suffered serious leg injuries," said an eyewitness, Iqbal Mankiya.The building was constructed by developers Dhananjay Raut and Rajiv Kotla of Sai Kiran Company after redeveloping an old structure.The three-year-old building's housing society was formed around two-and-a-half years ago."We had installed a spring mechanism in the lift as a safety measure," said Samir Dhonde, chairman of the housing society.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Mumbai | Silver Rate in Mumbai | Bank Holidays in Mumbai | Public Holidays in Mumbai | Mumbai AQI | Weather in Mumbai | Petrol Price in Mumbai | Diesel Price in Mumbai | CNG Price in Mumbai | LPG Price in MumbaiStay updated with the latest Mumbai news.
